description_en: Verifies whether a user's name, phone number, and ID card number are consistent
description_zh: 用于验证用户姓名、手机号和身份证号是否一致的API
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi virtual-three-elements-verification --auth-code XXXXXX --input-number 175XXXX6789 --mask NROAML --cert-name XX --cert-code '身份证号' --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: VirtualThreeElementsVerification

parameters.help_en: The authorization code. To obtain the authorization code, go to the My Applications page on the Phone Number Verification Service console and find the authorization ID
parameters.help_zh: 授权码。说明：在号码百科控制台 我的申请 页面，获取授权 ID 即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en:
The phone number to query.

If Mask is set to NORMAL, this field is an 11-digit phone number
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的号码。

若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为11位手机号码
parameters.name: input_number

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method. Valid values:

NORMAL: no encryption
parameters.help_zh:
加密方式。取值：

NORMAL：不加密
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en:
The ID card number to verify.

If Mask is set to NORMAL, this field is in plaintext
parameters.help_zh:
待核验的身份证号。

若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为明文
parameters.name: cert_code

IsConsistent.description_en:
Indicates whether the verification result is consistent. Valid values:
0: no record found
1: the phone number, ID card number, and name are consistent
2: inconsistent
IsConsistent.description_zh:
验证结果是否一致。返回：
0：查无记录
1：手机号、证件号、姓名一致
2：不一致
